snippet.title: The Untold Legends: BabaYaga
snippet.description:
#DFG #DFGGamingGear #BabaYaga #TheUntoldLegends:BabaYaga #Indiegames #Folklore 

Jayce is a kid gifted with the ability to lucid dream, allowing him to speak to those who are no longer living and solve mysteries from the past.

He wakes up in an unfamiliar place after being captured by Baba Yaga and is left in her home while she gathers ingredients to prepare him with. Not knowing where he is and having little access to his powers, Jayce must explore this expansive world and search for a way out.

The Untold Legends Baba Yaga attempts to bring the fantasy of reading folklore and urban legends to the world of video games. From the atmospheric world with suspenseful and exciting gameplay to the subtle story and dialogue allowing you to be your own character, experiencing the story first hand.
